content.title: The Box Model
content.hook: Every visible element occupies a box.
content.context:
For this lesson, use four layers from the inside out:

```css
content → padding → border → margin
```

Content is the thing itself. Padding adds space inside the border. Border draws the edge. Margin adds space outside the border.
goals: Understand content, padding, border, and margin as separate parts of an element box and predict how changing each one affects visible space.

content.title: See the layers

content.question: You increase padding from 8px to 24px. What should happen?

options.text: The space between the content and the border grows.
The space outside the element shrinks.
The element becomes a different HTML element.

feedback.correct: Padding is inside the border. Increasing it creates more inner space.
feedback.incorrect: Padding is inside the border. Increasing it creates more inner space.

content.question: You increase margin from 8px to 24px. What should happen?

options.text: The space between the content and the border grows.
The space outside the element grows.

feedback.correct: Margin is outside the border. Increasing it creates more outer space.
feedback.incorrect: Margin is outside the border. Increasing it creates more outer space.

feedback.correct: The requirement is inner space, so padding is the direct control.
feedback.incorrect: The requirement is inner space, so padding is the direct control.

content.title: The classic confusion
content.text:
Two cards look too close together. A learner increases padding. The text gets farther from each card edge, but the cards are still close to each other.

The learner changed the wrong layer for the original problem. The distance between neighboring elements is outside the box, so margin is the more direct control.

content.question:
Complete the sequence:

“Inside the content but before the border” = ________. “Outside the border” = ________.

feedback.correct: Padding is inside. Margin is outside.
feedback.incorrect: Padding is inside. Margin is outside.
